assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 12 records Affected version range as '"versions prior to the fix" (imprecise -- no specific threshold)' sourced from Description. Lines 45-46 explicitly flag: 'Affected version range: IMPRECISE -- Jira description says "versions prior to the fix" with no specific version threshold. External CVE data enrichment (Step 1.5) is required to determine the precise fix threshold.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries MITRE CVE API and extracts lessThan 0.4.8 as the fix threshold from the affected[].versions[] field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 13-21 show the MITRE CVE API was queried at https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48901. Extracted data includes 'Affected range: lessThan 0.4.8 (semver)' and 'Fix threshold: 0.4.8'. The lessThan 0.4.8 constraint is explicitly stated.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 23-34 show the OSV.dev API was queried at https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901. Extracted data includes 'Introduced: 0 (all versions from the beginning)' and 'Fixed: 0.4.8', which corresponds to the affected[].ranges[].events structure (introduced/fixed events). Line 34 confirms: 'All versions from 0 up to (but not including) 0.4.8 are affected.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 37-46 present a Cross-Validation Table showing both MITRE (< 0.4.8, fixed 0.4.8) and OSV.dev (introduced 0 fixed 0.4.8) with 'Precise' status. Line 46 states 'Agreement: MITRE and OSV.dev both report the same fix threshold of 0.4.8.' Line 48 declares 'Enriched fix threshold: 0.4.8'. version-impact.md line 5 confirms this value is used: 'Using the cross-validated fix threshold from Step 1.5: h2 < 0.4.8 is affected (fixed in 0.4.8).'

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md line 5 explicitly states: 'Using the cross-validated fix threshold from Step 1.5: h2 < 0.4.8 is affected (fixed in 0.4.8).' All version comparisons use 0.4.8 as the threshold (e.g., '0.4.5 < 0.4.8' for affected, '0.4.8 >= 0.4.8' for not affected). Lines 61-62 confirm: 'The enriched fix threshold from Step 1.5 (0.4.8) was essential for this analysis. The Jira description provided no usable version constraint ("versions prior to the fix" / "see advisory"). Without external CVE data enrichment, the version impact analysis could not have been performed.'
